projects.title: Create Albanian words
projects.description:
Shqiptarisht is an idea that has been on our minds for many years, almost 13 years, and finally, the conditions came together for this idea to come to life on a website (for which a word could also be invented) dedicated to creating new Albanian words, with the goal of “cleaning” and enriching our native language.

Based on a phenomenon we often encounter, the differences in the way objects, tools, professions, etc., are named, as well as the limitation of our language, Shqiptarisht aligns with a collaborative space, where Albanians can create new words for foreign expressions that are adopted…
